citation.title: Cephalometric Norms for Chinese Individuals Based on Expert Consensus Evaluation of Lateral Cephalometric Radiographs

curation.notes: Compared 2026-10-08 (norms:compare a vs b exit 1, 62 differences, none in a mean/SD/n except L1/OP). All 54 values re-read from the page image of Table 4 (p. 156, PDF p. 6): both extractors agree with the page on every mean and SD. Decisions: (1) source text: b's wording (Table 4, p. 156, with the definition in Table 3, p. 155) used for every row (a cited only Table 4) - prose, no value. (2) m62 L1/OP: a stored the printed 113.0/112.8, b printed − 90 (23.0/22.8) → b, by merge-notes ruling (catalogue m62 is the deviation from 90°, the #31 precedent); close (Table 3 names the 'functional plane'). (3) m22 FMA and m56 IMPA: a 'same', b 'close'. Superseded in fix round 1 by ruling P47 (review): Table 3 (p. 155, read from the page image) calls Go–Gn 'the mandibular plane' in its GoGn/SN row, the same words it uses for FMA and IMPA → IMPA moved to #59 L1–GoGn, same; FMA stays on #22 close (no FH–Go–Gn id), its note giving the Table 3 evidence; FMIA same (L1 to FH, no mandibular plane). (4) m61 OP/FH and m60 OP/SN: a 'close', b 'same' → close, 'occlusal plane not stated' (merge notes; Table 3 names the functional plane only for L1/OP). (5) Wits same: Table 3 says 'the functional occlusal plane', as the catalogue; no sign rule printed, values fit the catalogue sign. E-line same: no sign rule printed, values fit. (6) selection: a 'ideal-aesthetic', b 'class-I-balanced' → class-I-balanced (neutral occlusion AND expert-judged harmonious profile, p. 153). Region: 'Beijing (Peking University)'. Adult SNA SD 3.7 (Table 4) kept, Table 5's 3.6 in the note (merge notes). Scale not-stated (merge notes). SL, SE in caveats. Fix round 1 (2026-10-08, owner AGE-1 / MAL-1, rulings P42, P45, P47, review): IMPA → #59 (P47); FMA note; Y-axis note (points not named; S–Gn assumed, the conventional Y-axis).

caveats: Two groups, sexes pooled: adolescents n 60 (30 boys, 30 girls), age range 10-17 y (mean 14.40 ± 1.70), and adults n 60 (30 men, 30 women), age range 18-41 y (mean 24.33 ± 5.65) (p. 153). Table 4 gives no values by sex.

Selection: untreated Han Chinese orthodontic patients at Peking University (2022-2025), permanent dentition, neutral occlusion with normal overjet and overbite, straight profile judged harmonious by expert consensus (objective score < 3.30) (p. 153). These are 'harmonious' faces chosen by experts, so the spread is narrower than an unselected population's.
Measured on an online cephalometric platform (Zhejiang Aishinye); film or digital, film scale and head position are not stated. Anatomical porion used for FH (p. 154).
Not in the catalogue: SL (mm; pogonion projected onto SN, distance to sella) and SE (mm; posterior condyle projected onto SN, distance to sella), Peking University analysis (Table 3/4). Not entered.
L1/OP adult SD is printed 2.1 (adolescents 7.1; the other incisor angles have SDs of 6-10): possible typesetting error in the source. Kept as printed.
Adult SNA SD: Table 4 gives 3.7, Table 5 (p. 158) gives 3.6. Table 4, the norms table, is used.

Mandibular plane (ruling P47): Table 3 calls Go–Gn 'the mandibular plane' (GoGn/SN row) in the same words it uses for FMA and IMPA. IMPA is therefore entered as L1–GoGn (#59, same); FMA has no FH–Go–Gn id in the catalogue and stays on #22 (FH to the lower-border tangent), close. FMIA (L1 to FH) uses no mandibular plane and is same.
